grammar.syntax: Python arithmetic expression only. No eval, attributes, indexing, imports, arbitrary calls, exponent operator, strings or comprehensions. Fit constants appear as a0..a5.

physics.continuity: Conservative interval-domain certificate for every operation, plus sampled raw checks. Grid range/monotonicity checks are not a continuum proof; material rectangle here is a physics probe domain, not an empirically validated domain.

fitting.condition_weighting: Equal total squared-residual weight per material condition
fitting.rank_note: Report fitted Jacobian rank separately from affine material-coordinate rank. Non-collinear materials do not ensure expression-parameter identifiability or interaction coverage.
